name: AFK Display
summary: Players who stand still for a while have their name turned grey (tab list and name tag), so others can tell they are away. Moving again removes the grey name.

mechanics.title: AFK detection
mechanics.description: Every second a counter ticks up for each player. Every 150 seconds (2.5 minutes) the player's exact position is compared with the previous check; if X, Y and Z are all unchanged, the player joins the 'AFK Players' team (grey colour). Any change in position removes the player from the team within a second. The in-game advancement text says 5 minutes; the code checks every 150 s, so a player is flagged after roughly 2.5 to 5 minutes without moving.

qol: Grey name shows who is idle on multiplayer servers.
getting_started: Nothing to do. Stand still and your name turns grey.
editor_notes: Players on the team 'tg_tagged' (from another pack) are skipped. Timing: advancement text says 5 minutes, functions check every 150 s with an unchanged-position comparison, so the effective delay is 150-300 s depending on phase. Uses team colour gray, which also affects name colour in chat.
